client.dll.verdict: 0 Opcode Changes (100% Logic Identical) - Linker Displacement Re-alignment
client.dll.summary: Compiler Link-Time Code Generation (LTCG) string-pooling pass placed ConVar help strings in .rdata in a slightly different sequence (+120 bytes shift). This resulted in 27,256 32-bit RIP-relative displacement adjustments ([rip + disp32]) in .text referencing those strings. Across all 128,342 functions, zero assembly opcodes, branch conditions, or execution flows were modified.

sections..text: Code section: all 128,342 function boundaries in .pdata are identical. Every single byte diff is a 32-bit displacement operand inside LEA, MOV, MOVUPS, and CMP instructions pointing to .rdata.
sections..rdata: Read-only data: strings re-aligned by +120 bytes around ConVar descriptions (mp_dm_time_between_bonus_min, sv_matchpause_auto_5v5).
sections..data: Global data: pointer arrays shifted by +8 to +48 bytes to reference new string offsets in .rdata.
sections..pdata: Exception directory: 100% identical function unwind entries.
sections..reloc: Relocation table: decreased by 8 bytes (531,456 -> 531,448 B).
